contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C] TE[TR]IC[VS] P F AVG ; R/ VIRTVS A[VGG]

A worn and corroded cooper alloy radiate of Tetricus, reverse type soldier with spear and shield (AD 271-274). Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Tetricus I (?), radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C] TE[TR]IC[VS] P F AVG. Reverse description: Soldier, draped, cuirassed, standing left, holding spear in right hand and leaning on shield with left hand.
